description: Post-lowering AST conformance for the grids/duo cubed-sphere geometry templates (Phase 1). Exercises the whole geometry chain through the canonical pipeline at N=4: the six-tile const map application and index, the equiangular reference-line aggregates, the gnomonic normalisation, the renormalised cell centre, the spherical-excess area via the imported duo_spherical_angle atom (applied 4x/cell), and the C13/C14 metric via the imported duo_tangent_cos atom. No rules, no div, no BC regions -- a grid-geometry-only fixture. NLON-style sizing is a single metaparameter N=4 (smallest exercising all templates with a non-empty interior after the 3-layer halo).
